occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: The health statement for one child's file was not updated within 12 months of the child's enrollment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: A circle cycle was observed on the playground on concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation does not have a current fire inspection. The last documented fire inspection was completed on 3/19/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver does not have current CPR training. The previous certificate expired on 6/15/2026.

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The wall in the preschool room has several spots of paint peeling.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: Caregiver files do not have dates of hire listed on the file or on a document within the file.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: The driver and the director do not have a copy of their current driver's license on file.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were missing the following policies:    Details on outdoor activities. Suspension and expulsion policy. Safe Sleep policy. Quiet place for mothers to breast feed. Transportation. Whether or not the operation is going to put sunscreen or bug spray on the children. Whether or not the operation will keep an unassigned EPI pen on hand. The parent rights statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Staff did not have the required pre-employment affidavit in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: There is no fire extinguisher for the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
